title: Own 4GE1-style exam questions with indicative mark points (lesson 26)
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y10 lesson 26 (Own 4GE1-style exam questions with indicative mark points (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 26: Managing coasts: hard and soft engineering and SMPs (2.3b). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: 'Evaluate the use of hard engineering to protect coastlines.' Plan, then write in the portal response box.
questions.a: Balanced evaluation with examples (groynes, sea walls), downdrift effects, costs; justified conclusion
questions.model: Teacher plans with the class using the model.

questions.q: Explain why a council might choose 'no active intervention'.
questions.a: Low-value land (1); cost exceeds benefit (1); natural sediment supply to other areas (1)

questions.q: Explain how one stretch's policy affects another.
questions.a: Holding the line can cut sediment supply downdrift, increasing erosion elsewhere

questions.q: Give one advantage and one disadvantage of beach nourishment.
questions.a: Advantage: looks natural and supports tourism (1); disadvantage: sediment is washed away and must be replaced, costing money (1)
questions.model: Pro: natural, wider beach. Con: needs repeating. One mark each.
